name: @tranzmit/ledger
description: A shared ledger of definitions, findings, changes, and decisions that any coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) reads before work and writes after. MCP server + CLI over plain markdown in git.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.ui.json && node scripts/build-ui.mjs && chmod +x dist/cli.js
scripts.build:core: tsc -p tsconfig.core.json && tsc -p tsconfig.ui.json && node scripts/build-ui.mjs && chmod +x dist/cli.js
scripts.test:capture: npm run build && node dist/selftest-capture.js && node dist/selftest-capture-boundary.js
scripts.test:all: npm run build && node dist/selftest.js && node dist/selftest-events.js && node dist/selftest-authority.js && node dist/selftest-capture.js && node dist/selftest-capture-boundary.js && node dist/selftest-investigation.js && node dist/selftest-continuity.js && node dist/selftest-records.js && node dist/selftest-resume.js && node dist/selftest-classify.js && node dist/selftest-recordpack.js
